notes: Ask the Lanham coordinator for the semester due date, since the page does not list one for Lanham.
name: Luminis Health Student Volunteer Program (Doctors Community Medical Center, Lanham)
org: Luminis Health Doctors Community Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital you are placed in for a full semester. You work at least 3 hours a week.
who_can_apply: Students at least 16 years old by the orientation date. No grade rule listed. Needs proof of immunizations (MMR, varicella, hepatitis B, Tdap, current flu shot, TB screen).
duration: One semester, at least 3 hours per week
deadline_text: The Lanham campus was accepting student applications when read. Deadlines are listed only for the Annapolis campus (Summer May 1, Fall Aug 1, Spring Dec 1).
how_to_apply: Fill out the student form linked on the page. Go to the required orientation. Send shot records. The Lanham contact is Valerie Nicholas, Volunteer Coordinator. Her address is vnic100@luminishealth.org.
